notes: Recorded from the 2026 annex: 441 bachelor (including 7 entries printed as Applied Bachelor), 520 master (including 1 entry printed as Magister, no. 363), 212 doctorate = 1173 entries in total, one row per university offering.

Programme names are copied as the annex prints them, including its spelling (for example Boligy Education) and mixed naming such as Master in, Doctor of or Magister of in front of a field.
47 host universities in the 2026 annex. A programme listed for a university is offered at that university only; not every university offers every level.
Earlier SAS data set any_subject to true for this scholarship; the guidelines restrict the choice to the annex list, so it is set to false here.
The annex was read twice, by two independent text/table extractions of the PDF, and both gave identical rows.
